senses.gloss: (II)--a sage; the brother of बृहस्पति; wife, ममता. वा. ९९. ३६.
(I)--An अङ्गिरस् and मन्त्रकृत्। Br. I. ३२. १११.
(III)--a kind of hell. वा. १०१. १४९. [page१-136+ ३९]
--८००० मण्डलस् traversed by the sun in a year. Its own मण्डल in one day. वा. ५२. ४६.
--the sword; particularly that of शिव. वा. ३०. १२४; १०१. २७२.
--an apsaras. वा. ६९. 5.
(I)--R. in भारतवर्ष. भा. V. १९. १८.

(II)--the daughter of पञ्चजन (विरण-वि। प्।) the wife of दक्ष
1: भा. VI. 4. ५१; Vi. I. १५. ८९.
and the mother of हर्यश्वस् who were ten thousand in number (five thousand-वि। प्।) of शबलाश्वस् who were also a thousand in number
2: भा. VI. 5. 1, २४; Br. III. 2. 5, २१-30; Vi. I. १५. ९०, ९७.
and of sixty daughters.
3: भा. VI. 6. 1; Vi. I. १५. १०२.

(I)--a siddha--called on dying भीष्म.
1: भा. VI. १५. १२; I. 9. 7.
Invited for युध्ष्ठिर's sacrifice.
2: Ib. X. ७४. 7.
Came to Syamanta-पञ्चक to see कृष्ण.
3: Ib. X. ८४. 3.
One of the sages who left द्वारका for पिण्डा- raka.
4: Ib. XI. 1. १२.
Went with कृष्ण to मिथिला.
5: Ib. X. ८६. १८.
Acted as पुरोहित at कृष्ण's sacrifice in कुरुक्षेत्र.
6: Ib. X. ९०. ४६ [2].
Identified with Hari.
7: Ib. XI. १६. २८.
A place in the सरस्वती sacred to Asita.
8: Ib. III. 1. २२.

(II)--a gotrakara son of कश्यप, married Eka- पर्णा, daughter of हिमवान्: Father of Devala, the best among शाण्डिल्यस् and ब्रह्मिष्ठ (वा। प्।)। A Brahma- वादिन्. Not to marry with members of कश्यप and Devala.
2: M. १९९. १९.
A योगाचर्य; एकपर्णा, his wife, gave birth to Devala by her mind.
3: वा. ७२. १७.
^1 Br. II. ३२. ११२; III. 8. २९; १०. १८. M. १४५. १०७; वा. ५९. १०३; ७०. २५.

(III)--the sacred hill fit for श्राद्ध;
1: Br. III. १३. ३९.
the resi- dence of the sage Asita.
2: वा. ७७. ३९.
(IV)--the sage to whom the earth revealed the ignorance of worldly kings; this he reported to Janaka. Vi. IV. २४. १२७.
--an apsaras. Br. III. 7. 7.
--same as कुसुमोत्करम्। M. १२२. २४.
--a Bhairava on the sixth parva of गेयचक्र। Br. IV. १९. ७७-8.
--a lake in इलावृत. Vi. II. 2. २६. [page१-137+ ३०]
--a दानव. Br. III. 6. 5.

--one of २८ hells. Intended for those who leave the Vedic path to that of the पाखण्डस्; here their bodies are torn to pieces by the sharp edges of असिपत्र leaves (lit. forest where leaves are swords);
1: भा. V. २६. 7 & १५; Br. II. २८. ८४; IV. 2. १४९ and १७३; ३३. ६१; M. १४१. ७१; वा. १०१. १७०; Vi. I. 6. ४१; II. 6. 3.
in it fall those who cut and deal in camels and hunters who cut off animals, besides those fallen from karma.
2: वा. ५६. ७९; ११०. ४३.
Those that cut trees for no reason also fall into this.
3: Vi. II. 6. 3 and २६.
--an apsaras. Br. III. 7. 6.
(I)--a दानव, a son of Danu. Br. III. 6. 9; M. 6. २०; वा. ६८. 9.
(II)--a son of शम्भु. वा. ६७. ८१.

--the son of अश्वमेधज, and the father of Nemicakra;
1: भा. IX. २२. ३९.
was king when the वायु पुराण was uttered.
2: वा. 1. १२.
--कश्यपगोत्रकरस्. M. १९९. 9.
--the daughter of Bhaga and Siddhi. भा. VI. १८. 2.
